clips.title: The story
paras: In Sun Rock Retreat, Mor'rogal guides travelers toward the dangers and promise of the Stonetalon Mountains.

Mor'rogal watches the deep crevices and caverns of the Stonetalon Mountains from Sun Rock Retreat. Their twisting passages offer riches, but can also bring deadly danger. He sends brave Horde wanderers to troubled places such as Boulderslide Ravine. To Mor'rogal, facing those depths tests the spirit of anyone who seeks glory by following heart and soul.
